name: JavaScript - Conditional Logic
description: Learn about if statements and making decisions in code

rules.text: Create an input field, button, and result display
rules.hint: Add: <input type="text" id="userInput" placeholder="Enter a number"><button onclick="checkNumber()">Check Number</button><p id="result">Result will show here</p>

rules.text: Create a function that uses an if statement to check the number
rules.hint: Write: function checkNumber() { let num = document.getElementById('userInput').value; if (num > 10) { document.getElementById('result').innerHTML = 'Big number!'; } }

rules.text: Add an else statement to handle small numbers
rules.hint: Complete the function: function checkNumber() { let num = document.getElementById('userInput').value; if (num > 10) { document.getElementById('result').innerHTML = 'Big number!'; } else { document.getElementById('result').innerHTML = 'Small number!'; } }

completion.message: 🎉 Amazing! You can now make decisions in your code!
